import math

bool one_of(string value, string choices)
    return (" " + choices + " ").contains(" " + value + " ")

string[] words(string text)
    string[] result := []
    for part := text.split(" ")[]
        if part != ""
            result = result.append(part)
    return result

bool digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: position < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[position])
            return false
    return true

bool canonical(string text, int limit)
    return 0 < int(#text) <= limit and digits(text) and (#text == 1 or text[0] != "0")

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int month_days(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return if month == 2 and leap(year) then 29 else lengths[month - 1]

bool valid_date(string text)
    if #text != 10 or text[4] != "-" or text[7] != "-"
        return false
    year_text := text[0:<4]
    month_text := text[5:<7]
    day_text := text[8:<10]
    if not digits(year_text + month_text + day_text)
        return false
    year := int(year_text)
    month := int(month_text)
    day := int(day_text)
    return 2000 <= year <= 2059 and 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= month_days(year, month)

bool valid_clock(string text)
    if #text != 8 or text[2] != ":" or text[5] != ":"
        return false
    if not digits(text[0:<2] + text[3:<5] + text[6:<8])
        return false
    return int(text[0:<2]) < 24 and int(text[3:<5]) < 60 and int(text[6:<8]) < 60

bool valid_ip(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    if #parts != 4
        return false
    for part := parts[]
        if not canonical(part, 3) or int(part) > 255
            return false
    return true

int ip_number(string text)
    result := 0
    for part := text.split(".")[]
        result = result * 256 + int(part)
    return result

bool valid_status(string text)
    return #text == 3 and digits(text) and 100 <= int(text) <= 599

bool status_matches(string pattern, int status)
    if one_of(pattern, "1xx 2xx 3xx 4xx 5xx")
        return status / 100 == int(pattern[0])
    return status == int(pattern)

bool valid_filter(string key, string value)
    if key == "METHOD"
        return one_of(value, "GET HEAD POST PUT DELETE PATCH OPTIONS")
    if key == "STATUS"
        return one_of(value, "1xx 2xx 3xx 4xx 5xx") or valid_status(value)
    if key == "IP"
        return valid_ip(value)
    return value.starts_with("/")

string argument_error(string kind, string value, const string[] args)
    if one_of(kind, "limit minutes width threshold length times")
        upper := 100000
        if kind == "limit"
            upper = 100
        elif kind == "minutes"
            upper = 1440
        elif kind == "length"
            upper = 86400
        elif kind == "times"
            upper = 1000
        if not canonical(value, 6) or not (1 <= int(value) <= upper)
            return "invalid number"
    elif kind == "kind"
        if not one_of(value, "PATHS IPS")
            return "invalid kind"
    elif kind == "path"
        if not value.starts_with("/")
            return "invalid path"
    elif kind == "ip"
        if not valid_ip(value)
            return "invalid ip"
    elif kind == "date"
        if not valid_date(value)
            return "invalid timestamp"
    elif kind == "clock"
        if not valid_clock(value)
            return "invalid timestamp"
    elif kind == "key"
        if not one_of(value, "METHOD STATUS IP PATH")
            return "invalid key"
    elif kind == "subject"
        if not one_of(value, "METHOD STATUS IP PATH RANGE")
            return "invalid key"
    elif kind == "value"
        if not valid_filter(args[0], value)
            return "invalid value"
    return ""

string[] query_form(string command)
    if command == "TOP"
        return ["kind", "limit"]
    if command == "TIMELINE"
        return ["minutes"]
    if command == "LATENCY"
        return ["path"]
    if command == "HISTOGRAM"
        return ["width"]
    if command == "APDEX"
        return ["threshold"]
    if command == "SLOWEST"
        return ["limit"]
    if command == "SESSIONS"
        return ["ip", "minutes"]
    if command == "BURST"
        return ["length", "times"]
    if one_of(command, "PEAK GAPS")
        return ["length"]
    if command == "IP"
        return ["ip"]
    if command == "RANGE"
        return ["date", "clock", "date", "clock"]
    if command == "FILTER"
        return ["key", "value"]
    if command == "UNFILTER"
        return ["subject"]
    return []

string malformed_reason(const string[] fields)
    if #fields != 8
        return "fields"
    if not valid_date(fields[0])
        return "date"
    if not valid_clock(fields[1])
        return "time"
    if not valid_ip(fields[2])
        return "ip"
    if not one_of(fields[3], "GET HEAD POST PUT DELETE PATCH OPTIONS")
        return "method"
    if not fields[4].starts_with("/")
        return "path"
    if not valid_status(fields[5])
        return "status"
    if not canonical(fields[6], 8)
        return "bytes"
    if not canonical(fields[7], 6)
        return "latency"
    return ""

int seconds_of(string date, string clock)
    year := int(date[0:<4])
    month := int(date[5:<7])
    int days := int(date[8:<10]) - 1
    for: 2000 <= prior < year
        days += if leap(prior) then 366 else 365
    for: 1 <= prior < month
        days += month_days(year, prior)
    return days * 86400 + int(clock[0:<2]) * 3600 + int(clock[3:<5]) * 60 + int(clock[6:<8])

string padded(int value, int width)
    text := string(value)
    return "0" * nat(math.max(0, width - int(#text))) + text

string interval_label(int seconds)
    days := seconds / 86400
    minutes := seconds % 86400 / 60
    year := 2000
    while days >= (if leap(year) then 366 else 365)
        days -= if leap(year) then 366 else 365
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while days >= month_days(year, month)
        days -= month_days(year, month)
        month += 1
    return "{year}-{padded(month, 2)}-{padded(days + 1, 2)} {padded(minutes / 60, 2)}:{padded(minutes % 60, 2)}"

string normalize_path(string raw)
    string[] parts := []
    path := raw.split("?")[0]
    for part := path.split("/")[]
        if part == ".."
            if #parts > 0
                parts = parts[0:<int(#parts) - 1]
        elif part != "" and part != "."
            parts = parts.append(part)
    result := "/"
    for: position < #parts
        part := parts[position]
        if digits(part)
            part = "{{id}}"
        elif #part >= 8
            hexadecimal := true
            has_digit := false
            for: offset < #part
                hexadecimal = hexadecimal and "0123456789abcdef".contains(part[offset])
                has_digit = has_digit or "0123456789".contains(part[offset])
            if hexadecimal and has_digit
                part = "{{hex}}"
        if position > 0
            result += "/"
        result += part
    return result

string decimal(int numerator, int denominator, int places)
    scale := 10 ^ places
    value := numerator * scale / denominator
    return "{value / scale}.{padded(value % scale, places)}"

string percentage(int amount, int total)
    return decimal(amount * 100, total, 2) + "%"

string byte_text(int size)
    if size >= 1073741824
        return decimal(size, 1073741824, 1) + "GB"
    if size >= 1048576
        return decimal(size, 1048576, 1) + "MB"
    if size >= 1024
        return decimal(size, 1024, 1) + "KB"
    return "{size}B"

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void bar_line(string label, int count, int maximum)
    if count == 0
        emit("{label} 0")
    else
        string bar := "#" * nat((count * 30 + maximum - 1) / maximum)
        emit("{label} {count} {bar}")

class LogData()
    line_count := 0
    string[] dates := []
    string[] stamps := []
    string[] ips := []
    string[] methods := []
    string[] paths := []
    int[] moments := []
    int[] hours := []
    int[] statuses := []
    int[] sizes := []
    int[] latencies := []
    int[] ip_codes := []
    int[] bad_lines := []
    string[] bad_reasons := []
    int[] order := []
    method_filter := ""
    status_filter := ""
    ip_filter := ""
    path_filter := ""
    first_second := -1
    last_second := -1
    first_label := ""
    last_label := ""

    void .ingest(string text)
        line_count += 1
        fields := words(text)
        reason := malformed_reason(fields)
        if reason != ""
            bad_lines = bad_lines.append(line_count)
            bad_reasons = bad_reasons.append(reason)
            return
        dates = dates.append(fields[0])
        stamps = stamps.append(fields[0] + " " + fields[1])
        ips = ips.append(fields[2])
        methods = methods.append(fields[3])
        paths = paths.append(normalize_path(fields[4]))
        moments = moments.append(seconds_of(fields[0], fields[1]))
        hours = hours.append(int(fields[1][0:<2]))
        statuses = statuses.append(int(fields[5]))
        sizes = sizes.append(int(fields[6]))
        latencies = latencies.append(int(fields[7]))
        ip_codes = ip_codes.append(ip_number(fields[2]))

    void .prepare()
        map<int, int> positions
        length := int(#moments)
        for: 0 <= index < length
            .positions.set(moments[index] * (length + 1) + index, index)
        order = []
        for key := positions.keys().sorted()[]
            match positions.get(key)
                int index
                    order = order.append(index)
                none
                    process.exit(1)

    int[] selected()
        int[] result := []
        for index := order[]
            if first_second >= 0 and not (first_second <= moments[index] <= last_second)
                continue
            if method_filter != "" and methods[index] != method_filter
                continue
            if status_filter != "" and not status_matches(status_filter, statuses[index])
                continue
            if ip_filter != "" and ips[index] != ip_filter
                continue
            if path_filter != "" and paths[index] != path_filter
                continue
            result = result.append(index)
        return result

    string key_at(int index, string kind)
        if kind == "IP"
            return ips[index]
        if kind == "METHOD"
            return methods[index]
        if kind == "DATE"
            return dates[index]
        if kind == "ENDPOINT"
            return paths[index] + " " + methods[index]
        return paths[index]

    int unique_count(const int[] members, string kind)
        distinct<string> seen
        for index := members[]
            .seen.add(key_at(index, kind))
        return int(seen.size())

class Group(string label, int tie, int[] members, local const LogData data, local int threshold)
    count := int(#members)
    int bytes := data.sizes[members].sum()
    int total_latency := data.latencies[members].sum()
    int maximum := data.latencies[members].max()
    local int[] codes := data.statuses[members]
    local int[] delays := data.latencies[members]
    local failures := codes[codes >= 400]
    client := int(#failures[failures < 500])
    server := int(#codes[codes >= 500])
    local eligible := delays[codes < 500]
    satisfied := int(#eligible[eligible <= threshold])
    local slower := eligible[eligible > threshold]
    tolerating := int(#slower[slower <= 4 * threshold])
    peak_count := 0
    peak_first := 0
    peak_last := 0

    int points()
        return 2 * satisfied + tolerating

    string rating()
        int score := points() * 100
        total := 2 * count
        if score >= 94 * total
            return "excellent"
        if score >= 85 * total
            return "good"
        if score >= 70 * total
            return "fair"
        if score >= 50 * total
            return "poor"
        return "unacceptable"

Group[] grouped(const LogData data, const int[] members, string kind, threshold := 0)
    map<string, int[]> buckets
    for index := members[]
        key := data.key_at(index, kind)
        int[] bucket := []
        match buckets.get(key)
            int[] existing
                bucket = existing
            none
                bucket = []
        .buckets.set(key, bucket.append(index))
    Group[] result := []
    names := buckets.keys().sorted()
    for: position < #names
        key := names[position]
        match buckets.get(key)
            int[] bucket
                tie := if kind == "IP" then data.ip_codes[bucket[0]] else int(position)
                result = result.append(Group(key, tie, bucket, data, threshold))
            none
                process.exit(1)
    return result

bool group_before(const Group left, const Group right, string mode)
    comparison := right.count - left.count
    if mode == "APDEX"
        comparison = left.points() * right.count - right.points() * left.count
        if comparison == 0
            comparison = right.count - left.count
    elif mode == "ERRORS"
        left_errors := left.client + left.server
        right_errors := right.client + right.server
        comparison = right_errors * left.count - left_errors * right.count
        if comparison == 0
            comparison = right_errors - left_errors
    elif mode == "SLOWEST"
        comparison = right.total_latency * left.count - left.total_latency * right.count
        if comparison == 0
            comparison = right.maximum - left.maximum
    elif mode == "BURST"
        comparison = right.peak_count - left.peak_count
    return if comparison != 0 then comparison < 0 else left.tie < right.tie

Group[] ranked(const Group[] values, string mode)
    length := int(#values)
    if length < 2
        return values
    middle := length / 2
    left := ranked(values[0:<middle], mode)
    right := ranked(values[middle:], mode)
    Group[] result := []
    i := 0
    j := 0
    while i < int(#left) and j < int(#right)
        if group_before(right[j], left[i], mode)
            result = result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
        else
            result = result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
    if i < int(#left)
        result = result.concat(left[i:])
    if j < int(#right)
        result = result.concat(right[j:])
    return result

(int, int, int) peak(const LogData data, const int[] members, int width)
    begin := 0
    best := 0
    first_index := members[0]
    last_index := members[0]
    for: 0 <= end < int(#members)
        while data.moments[members[end]] - data.moments[members[begin]] >= width
            begin += 1
        if end - begin + 1 > best
            best = end - begin + 1
            first_index = members[begin]
            last_index = members[end]
    return (best, first_index, last_index)

void run_query(LogData &data, string command, const string[] args, const int[] ids)
    n := int(#ids)
    if command == "SUMMARY"
        ip_count := data.unique_count(ids, "IP")
        path_count := data.unique_count(ids, "PATH")
        emit("SUMMARY lines {data.line_count} valid {#data.moments} malformed {#data.bad_lines}")
        emit("requests {n} bytes {data.sizes[ids].sum()} ips {ip_count} paths {path_count}")
        if n == 0
            emit("span none")
        else
            emit("span {data.stamps[ids[0]]} {data.stamps[ids[n - 1]]} {data.moments[ids[n - 1]] - data.moments[ids[0]]}")
    elif command == "MALFORMED"
        emit("MALFORMED {#data.bad_lines}")
        for reason := "fields date time ip method path status bytes latency".split(" ")[]
            int[] lines := []
            for: position < #data.bad_lines
                if data.bad_reasons[position] == reason
                    lines = lines.append(data.bad_lines[position])
            if #lines > 0
                print("{reason} {#lines}")
                for number := lines[]
                    print(" {number}")
                println()
    elif command == "STATUS"
        emit("STATUS {n}")
        int[] codes := data.statuses[ids]
        for: 1 <= category <= 5
            subset := codes[codes >= category * 100]
            count := int(#subset[subset < (category + 1) * 100])
            emit("{category}xx {count} {percentage(count, n)}")
        previous := -1
        for code := codes.sorted()[]
            if code == previous
                continue
            previous = code
            subset := codes[codes >= code]
            count := int(#subset[subset <= code])
            emit("{code} {count} {percentage(count, n)}")
    elif command == "METHODS" or command == "TOP"
        kind := if command == "METHODS" then "METHOD" elif args[0] == "IPS" then "IP" else "PATH"
        groups := ranked(grouped(data, ids, kind), "COUNT")
        int shown := if command == "METHODS" then int(#groups) else math.min<int>(int(args[1]), int(#groups))
        if command == "METHODS"
            emit("METHODS {n}")
        else
            emit("TOP {args[0]} {shown} of {#groups}")
        rank := 0
        for: 0 <= position < shown
            item := groups[position]
            if position == 0 or item.count != groups[position - 1].count
                rank = position + 1
            if command == "TOP"
                print("{rank} ")
            emit("{item.label} {item.count} {percentage(item.count, n)}")
    elif command == "HOURLY"
        counts := array(24, fill = 0)
        for index := ids[]
            counts[data.hours[index]] += 1
        maximum := counts.max()
        first_hour := 0
        while counts[first_hour] != maximum
            first_hour += 1
        emit("HOURLY {n} peak {padded(first_hour, 2)} {maximum}")
        for: 0 <= hour < 24
            bar_line(padded(hour, 2), counts[hour], maximum)
    elif command == "TIMELINE" or command == "HISTOGRAM"
        parameter := int(args[0])
        width := if command == "TIMELINE" then 60 * parameter else parameter
        int[] values := if command == "TIMELINE" then data.moments[ids] / width else data.latencies[ids] / width
        low := values.min()
        high := values.max()
        if high - low + 1 > 60
            emit("ERROR too many buckets")
            return
        counts := array(nat(high - low + 1), fill = 0)
        for value := values[]
            counts[value - low] += 1
        emit("{command} {parameter} {#counts}")
        maximum := counts.max()
        for: 0 <= position < int(#counts)
            begin := (low + position) * width
            label := if command == "TIMELINE" then interval_label(begin) else "{begin}-{begin + width - 1}"
            bar_line(label, counts[position], maximum)
    elif command == "BANDWIDTH" or command == "VISITORS"
        days := grouped(data, ids, "DATE")
        if command == "BANDWIDTH"
            int total := data.sizes[ids].sum()
            emit("BANDWIDTH {#days} {total} {byte_text(total)}")
            for day := days[]
                emit("{day.label} {day.count} {day.bytes} {byte_text(day.bytes)}")
        else
            distinct<string> visited
            ip_count := data.unique_count(ids, "IP")
            emit("VISITORS {#days} {ip_count}")
            for day := days[]
                distinct<string> today
                newcomers := 0
                for index := day.members[]
                    address := data.ips[index]
                    if not visited.has(address)
                        .visited.add(address)
                        newcomers += 1
                    .today.add(address)
                emit("{day.label} unique {today.size()} new {newcomers} returning {int(today.size()) - newcomers}")
    elif command == "LATENCY"
        members := ids
        label := "all"
        if #args > 0
            label = normalize_path(args[0])
            members = []
            for index := ids[]
                if data.paths[index] == label
                    members = members.append(index)
        count := int(#members)
        if count == 0
            emit("LATENCY no records")
            return
        int[] values := data.latencies[members].sorted()
        trim := count / 10
        trimmed := values[trim:<count - trim]
        mean := decimal(values.sum(), count, 2)
        trimmed_mean := decimal(trimmed.sum(), int(#trimmed), 2)
        emit("LATENCY {label} count {count} min {values[0]} p50 {values[(50 * count + 99) / 100 - 1]} p90 {values[(90 * count + 99) / 100 - 1]} p99 {values[(99 * count + 99) / 100 - 1]} max {values[count - 1]} mean {mean} trimmed {trimmed_mean}")
    elif command == "APDEX"
        threshold := int(args[0])
        overall := Group("", 0, ids, data, threshold)
        emit("APDEX {threshold} {decimal(overall.points(), 2 * n, 3)} {overall.rating()} satisfied {overall.satisfied} tolerating {overall.tolerating} frustrated {n - overall.satisfied - overall.tolerating}")
        for item := ranked(grouped(data, ids, "PATH", threshold), "APDEX")[]
            emit("{item.label} {decimal(item.points(), 2 * item.count, 3)} {item.rating()} {item.count}")
    elif command == "ERRORS"
        int[] codes := data.statuses[ids]
        failed := int(#codes[codes >= 400])
        emit("ERRORS {failed} of {n} {percentage(failed, n)}")
        for item := ranked(grouped(data, ids, "PATH"), "ERRORS")[]
            failures := item.client + item.server
            if failures > 0
                emit("{item.label} {item.count} {item.client} {item.server} {percentage(failures, item.count)}")
    elif command == "SLOWEST"
        groups := ranked(grouped(data, ids, "ENDPOINT"), "SLOWEST")
        int shown := math.min<int>(int(args[0]), int(#groups))
        emit("SLOWEST {shown} of {#groups}")
        for: 0 <= position < shown
            item := groups[position]
            sample := item.members[0]
            emit("{position + 1} {data.methods[sample]} {data.paths[sample]} count {item.count} avg {decimal(item.total_latency, item.count, 2)} max {item.maximum}")
    elif command == "SESSIONS" or command == "IP"
        int[] found := []
        for index := ids[]
            if data.ips[index] == args[0]
                found = found.append(index)
        count := int(#found)
        if count == 0
            emit("{command} no records")
            return
        if command == "SESSIONS"
            int minutes := if #args == 2 then int(args[1]) else 30
            starts := [0]
            for: 1 <= position < count
                if data.moments[found[position]] - data.moments[found[position - 1]] > minutes * 60
                    starts = starts.append(position)
            starts = starts.append(count)
            session_count := int(#starts) - 1
            int[] durations := []
            for: 0 <= position < session_count
                durations = durations.append(data.moments[found[starts[position + 1] - 1]] - data.moments[found[starts[position]]])
            emit("SESSIONS {args[0]} timeout {minutes} count {session_count} requests {count} avg_duration {decimal(durations.sum(), session_count, 1)} avg_requests {decimal(count, session_count, 1)}")
            for: 0 <= position < session_count
                session := found[starts[position]:<starts[position + 1]]
                path_count := data.unique_count(session, "PATH")
                emit("{position + 1} {data.stamps[session[0]]} {data.stamps[session[-1]]} {durations[position]} {#session} {path_count}")
        else
            int[] codes := data.statuses[found]
            failed := int(#codes[codes >= 400])
            path_count := data.unique_count(found, "PATH")
            emit("IP {args[0]} requests {count} bytes {data.sizes[found].sum()} errors {failed} paths {path_count}")
            emit("first {data.stamps[found[0]]} last {data.stamps[found[count - 1]]}")
            print("methods")
            for item := ranked(grouped(data, found, "METHOD"), "COUNT")[]
                print(" {item.label} {item.count}")
            print(NL + "classes")
            for: 1 <= category <= 5
                subset := codes[codes >= category * 100]
                amount := int(#subset[subset < (category + 1) * 100])
                print(" {category}xx {amount}")
            println()
            paths := ranked(grouped(data, found, "PATH"), "COUNT")
            for: 0 <= position < math.min(3, int(#paths))
                emit("path {paths[position].label} {paths[position].count}")
    elif command == "BURST"
        width := int(args[0])
        threshold := int(args[1])
        int[] codes := data.statuses[ids]
        failed := ids[codes >= 400]
        Group[] candidates := []
        for item := grouped(data, failed, "IP")[]
            count, first, last := peak(data, item.members, width)
            if count >= threshold
                item.peak_count = count
                item.peak_first = first
                item.peak_last = last
                candidates = candidates.append(item)
        emit("BURST {width} {threshold} {#candidates}")
        for item := ranked(candidates, "BURST")[]
            emit("{item.label} {item.peak_count} {data.stamps[item.peak_first]} {data.stamps[item.peak_last]}")
    elif command == "PEAK"
        width := int(args[0])
        count, first, last := peak(data, ids, width)
        emit("PEAK {width} {count} {data.stamps[first]} {data.stamps[last]}")
    elif command == "GAPS"
        width := int(args[0])
        int[] gaps := []
        for: 1 <= position < n
            if data.moments[ids[position]] - data.moments[ids[position - 1]] >= width
                gaps = gaps.append(position)
        emit("GAPS {width} {#gaps}")
        for position := gaps[]
            first := ids[position - 1]
            last := ids[position]
            emit("{data.stamps[first]} {data.stamps[last]} {data.moments[last] - data.moments[first]}")
    elif command == "RANGE"
        first := seconds_of(args[0], args[1])
        last := seconds_of(args[2], args[3])
        if first > last
            emit("ERROR invalid range")
            return
        data.first_second = first
        data.last_second = last
        data.first_label = args[0] + " " + args[1]
        data.last_label = args[2] + " " + args[3]
        emit("RANGE {data.first_label} {data.last_label} active {#data.selected()}")
    elif command == "FILTER" or command == "UNFILTER"
        key := args[0]
        if key == "RANGE"
            if data.first_second < 0
                emit("ERROR not filtered")
                return
            data.first_second = -1
            data.last_second = -1
        else
            string &destination
            if key == "METHOD"
                &destination = &data.method_filter
            elif key == "STATUS"
                &destination = &data.status_filter
            elif key == "IP"
                &destination = &data.ip_filter
            else
                &destination = &data.path_filter
            if command == "UNFILTER"
                if destination == ""
                    emit("ERROR not filtered")
                    return
                destination = ""
            else
                destination = if key == "PATH" then normalize_path(args[1]) else args[1]
                emit("FILTER {key} {destination} active {#data.selected()}")
                return
        emit("UNFILTER {key} active {#data.selected()}")
    elif command == "RESET"
        data.method_filter = ""
        data.status_filter = ""
        data.ip_filter = ""
        data.path_filter = ""
        data.first_second = -1
        data.last_second = -1
        emit("RESET active {#data.selected()}")
    elif command == "STATE"
        period := if data.first_second < 0 then "-" else data.first_label + " " + data.last_label
        method := if data.method_filter == "" then "-" else data.method_filter
        status := if data.status_filter == "" then "-" else data.status_filter
        ip := if data.ip_filter == "" then "-" else data.ip_filter
        path := if data.path_filter == "" then "-" else data.path_filter
        emit("STATE active {n} range {period} method {method} status {status} ip {ip} path {path}")

void execute(LogData &data, string text)
    fields := words(text)
    command := fields[0]
    if not one_of(command, "SUMMARY MALFORMED STATUS METHODS TOP HOURLY TIMELINE BANDWIDTH VISITORS LATENCY HISTOGRAM APDEX ERRORS SLOWEST SESSIONS BURST PEAK GAPS IP RANGE FILTER UNFILTER RESET STATE")
        emit("ERROR unknown query")
        return
    string[] args := []
    if #fields > 1
        args = fields[1:]
    form := query_form(command)
    count := int(#args)
    maximum := int(#form)
    minimum := maximum - (if one_of(command, "LATENCY SESSIONS") then 1 else 0)
    if count < minimum or count > maximum
        emit("ERROR wrong arguments")
        return
    for: 0 <= position < count
        reason := argument_error(form[position], args[position], args)
        if reason != ""
            emit("ERROR {reason}")
            return
    members := data.selected()
    if #members == 0 and one_of(command, "STATUS METHODS TOP HOURLY TIMELINE BANDWIDTH VISITORS HISTOGRAM APDEX ERRORS SLOWEST BURST PEAK GAPS")
        emit("{command} no records")
        return
    run_query(&data, command, args, members)

analyzer := LogData()
while true
    string input_line
    scan(&input_line)
    if input_line == "---"
        break
    .analyzer.ingest(input_line)
.analyzer.prepare()
while true
    string input_line
    scan(&input_line)
    if input_line == "END"
        break
    execute(&analyzer, input_line)
